metadata.article_title: Termination of gratuitous bailment by death.

article.title: Termination of gratuitous bailment by death.
article.content: A gratuitous bailment is terminated by the death either of the bailor or of the bailee.
article.html:
162Termination of gratuitous bailment by death.

Section 162 · Chapter IX · page 41 of the Act

A gratuitous bailment is terminated by the death either of the bailor or of the bailee.
